title: Identify male patients diagnosed with SLE who had laboratory tests between
question: Identify male patients diagnosed with SLE who had laboratory tests between 1985 and 1995, exhibited abnormal GOT levels (≥60), and had uric acid within the normal male range (≤8.0). For each such patient, return their ID, age at the time of the lab test, total cholesterol value, and a flag indicating whether their cholesterol was high (≥250).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    L."XCL_016" AS age_at_test,
    L."XCL_026" AS total_cholesterol,
    CASE WHEN L."XCL_026" >= 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cholesterol_high_flag
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND P."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND L."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
  AND L."XCL_017" >= 60
  AND L."XCL_022" <= 8.0

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    CAST(julianday(L."XCL_015") - julianday(P."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) / 365 AS age_at_test,
    L."XCL_018" AS total_cholesterol,
    CASE WHEN L."XCL_018" >= 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cholesterol_high_flag
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND E."XCL_008" = 'SLE'
  AND L."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
  AND L."XCL_016" >= 60
  AND L."XCL_017" <= 8.0
